description: A compressor with a side-chain, a resonant high pass after it, and the envelope available both as an output and as a sweep of that filter

params.text: Sets the attack time of the envelope follower, about 0.2ms at fully counter-clockwise to 0.8 seconds fully clockwise
Sets the decay time of the envelope follower, about 2ms at fully counter-clockwise to 1.3 seconds fully clockwise
Sets the level compression starts at, about 0.3V at fully counter-clockwise to 10V fully clockwise
Sets the ratio, 256 to 1 at fully counter-clockwise through 4 to 1 at its default and into expansion fully clockwise
Sets the corner of the high pass after the compressor, eight octaves below to two above C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets the resonance of the high pass, -6dB at fully counter-clockwise to 12dB fully clockwise
Blends in a make-up gain that lifts the compressed signal back toward the level it went in at, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets how far the gain reduction moves the high pass corner, two octaves either way for every 6dB of reduction

inputs.text: Moves the high pass corner one octave per volt on top of the CUT knob
The signal the envelope follower reads; with nothing patched here it follows the module's own input

outputs.text: The high pass corner as a 1V per octave pitch, the CUT knob and its input with the envelope amount added
The envelope follower's output: the side-chain rectified and smoothed by the attack and decay knobs
The compressed signal after the high pass, blended with its make-up gain by the MIX knob

notes: the ratio knob is configured with its ends reversed, so turning it clockwise moves from heavy limiting through 4 to 1 and on into expansion
the side-chain jack is normalled from the audio input, so the compressor works with nothing patched there

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the audio input.

bipolar · continuous · polyphonic
